scope: 138 paced repetitions of the same authored Japanese fixture. Real Silero, MLX Whisper and HY-MT 1.5 on one Mac. Repeated text mostly hits translation cache. Snapshot precedes final phrase-hint and TTS/pure-laughter presentation fixes. This is a continuity check, not diverse uncached translation throughput, semantic accuracy, or a controlled thermal comparison.

notes: End-of-window latency excludes the pause used to close that window.
Round-end queue snapshots are not a peak queue measurement.
Main-process RSS excludes model and audio subprocesses.
Ordinary browser playback and desktop activity were not isolated. The installed desktop microphone session was found active near the end and stopped; this run is not a controlled speed benchmark.
All sampled thermal states were fair. Optional acoustic tone classification was skipped; no degrees-C temperature was measured.
